d:
Enjoy “Teri Isi Ada Pe Sanam” from the hit Hindi film Deewana (1992), featuring Rishi Kapoor and Divya Bharti. Sung by the melodious duo Kumar Sanu and Sadhana Sargam, this romantic number brings back the magic of classic Hindi film music and the golden sound of the 90s.
Teri Isi Ada Pe Sanam | Deewana 1992 | Divya Bharti, Rishi Kapoor | Kumar-Sadhana |Superhit 90s Song
Song : Teri Isi Ada Pe Sanam
Movie: Deewana (1992)
Star Cast : Rishi Kapoor, Divya Bharti
Singers: Kumar Sanu, Sadhana Sargam
Music Director: Nadeem–Shravan
Lyricist: Sameer
